def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    vehicle_hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", len(customers)) or len(customers)

    if not customers:
        return []

    def route_cost(r):
        if not r:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][r[0]] + matrix[r[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(r) - 1):
            c += matrix[r[i]][r[i + 1]]
        return c

    def is_feasible(r):
        load = 0
        for v in r:
            load += demands[v]
            if load > capacity:
                return False
        return True

    def route_load(r):
        s = 0
        for v in r:
            s += demands[v]
        return s

    def best_oriented_merge(ri, rj, at_i, at_j):
        # at_i: 0 means left end of ri, 1 means right end; same for rj
        # Return merged route list or None if orientation not possible.
        if at_i == 1 and at_j == 0:
            return ri + rj
        if at_i == 0 and at_j == 1:
            return rj + ri
        if at_i == 0 and at_j == 0:
            return list(reversed(ri)) + rj
        if at_i == 1 and at_j == 1:
            return ri + list(reversed(rj))
        return None

    def two_opt(route):
        # deterministic first-improvement 2-opt with depot already handled implicitly
        n = len(route)
        if n < 4:
            return route
        best = route
        best_cost = route_cost(best)
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            # limit moves for speed
            for i in range(n - 1):
                a = best[i - 1] if i > 0 else None
                b = best[i]
                for k in range(i + 1, n):
                    c = best[k]
                    d = best[k + 1] if k + 1 < n else None
                    # compute delta safely with depot at ends
                    if a is None:
                        old1 = matrix[depot][b]
                    else:
                        old1 = matrix[a][b]
                    if d is None:
                        old2 = matrix[c][depot]
                    else:
                        old2 = matrix[c][d]
                    if a is None:
                        new1 = matrix[depot][c]
                    else:
                        new1 = matrix[a][c]
                    if d is None:
                        new2 = matrix[b][depot]
                    else:
                        new2 = matrix[b][d]
                    if new1 + new2 < old1 + old2:
                        cand = best[:i] + list(reversed(best[i:k + 1])) + best[k + 1:]
                        if route_load(cand) <= capacity:
                            cand_cost = route_cost(cand)
                            if cand_cost < best_cost:
                                best = cand
                                best_cost = cand_cost
                                improved = True
                                break
                if improved:
                    break
        return best

    # Start each customer as own route
    routes = [[v] for v in customers]
    rload = {i: demands[v] for i, v in enumerate(customers)}
    node_to_route = {}
    for i, v in enumerate(customers):
        node_to_route[v] = i

    # If hint is small, encourage merging; if hint is large, be cautious (still merge if good)
    # Build savings list
    savings = []
    # Only consider pairs among customers; deterministically iterate in given order
    # Savings = dist(i,depot)+dist(depot,j)-dist(i,j)
